short_test_copy_scope.scope: Isolated 120-frame real-loop test; not a full 6573-frame movie run
changes: BA_REALTIME passes 120 to the unchanged BA_RUN_REALTIME and emits audit after playback
BA_RUN iterates 0..119, waits for 120/30 seconds, reports 120; its actual sequential render/present body is unchanged
short_test_copy_scope.diff:
--- production PLAYER.ERB
+++ isolated short-test PLAYER.ERB
@@ -332,7 +332,7 @@
 SETCOLOR 255, 255, 255
 SETBGCOLOR 0, 0, 0
 BA_STARTMS = GETMILLISECOND()
-FOR LF, 0, BA_FRAMES
+FOR LF, 0, 120
     LTIME = GETMILLISECOND()
     CALL BA_RENDER, LF
     BA_CALCMS += GETMILLISECOND() - LTIME
@@ -354,7 +354,7 @@
     ENDIF
 NEXT
 IF LPACED
-    LW = BA_STARTMS + BA_FRAMES * 1000 / BA_FPS - GETMILLISECOND()
+    LW = BA_STARTMS + 120 * 1000 / BA_FPS - GETMILLISECOND()
     SIF LW > 0
         AWAIT LW
 ENDIF
@@ -362,7 +362,7 @@
 CLEARLINE BA_SHOWN
 BA_SHOWN = 0
 REDRAW 3
-PRINTFORML Completed {BA_FRAMES} / {BA_FRAMES} frames. Elapsed: {BA_ELAPSEDMS} ms.
+PRINTFORML Completed {120} / {120} frames. Elapsed: {BA_ELAPSEDMS} ms.
 PRINTFORML Calculation and row construction: {BA_CALCMS} ms; presentation: {BA_PRESENTMS} ms.
 SIF LPACED
     PRINTFORML Maximum lateness: {BA_MAXLATE} ms; late by over one frame: {BA_LATEFRAMES}.
@@ -396,8 +396,8 @@
 ; and the curve chains of spans alive at the selected target.
 ; GETMILLISECOND is the engine's wall-clock query, not a monotonic clock.
 @BA_REALTIME
-BA_RT_AUDIT = 0
-CALL BA_RUN_REALTIME, BA_FRAMES
+BA_RT_AUDIT = 1
+CALL BA_RUN_REALTIME, 120
 RETURN RESULT
 
 ; Identical movie loop; only the post-movie diagnostic emission differs.
